page: Microsoft Azure M416ds_6_v3 is a memory-optimized server instance belonging to the MDSHighMemoryv3 family. Built on the x86_64 architecture and virtualized via Microsoft Hyper-V, the system provides 416 dedicated Intel vCPUs. It features 5696.0 GB of system memory, yielding an allocation of 13.69 GB of RAM per vCPU. The instance operates without discrete GPU accelerators, focusing hardware resources entirely on central processing and high-density memory operations.

Storage features include 429 GB of bundled local SSD space, intended primarily for temporary scratch files, swap space, or caching. The instance also supports Premium Storage attachments to handle persistent workloads. Given the ratio of 429 GB local storage to 5696.0 GB of RAM, the onboard disk space is minimal relative to the memory footprint. In terms of resource investment, deploying such high-density compute and memory infrastructure represents an enterprise-tier commitment, justifiable when workloads demand single-system consolidation without partitioning across distributed nodes.

This platform is suited for memory-intensive enterprise environments, including massive in-memory databases such as SAP HANA, large-scale enterprise resource planning systems, high-throughput transactional database management systems, and intensive in-memory data processing pipelines.
description: Microsoft Azure M416ds_6_v3 is an enterprise-scale memory-optimized virtual machine operating on Microsoft Hyper-V. Built on the x86_64 architecture using Intel processors, it provides 416 dedicated vCPUs paired with 5696.0 GB of system memory, delivering approximately 13.69 GB of RAM per vCPU. The instance does not include GPU acceleration. For ephemeral data needs, it integrates 429 GB of local SSD storage and supports Premium Storage configurations for persistent disk attachments. With its high density of compute cores and substantial memory allocation, resource costs reflect its top-tier enterprise profile. Organizations must evaluate memory footprint requirements carefully, as the relatively small 429 GB local storage implies that large persistent datasets require external network-attached volumes. The hardware configuration makes this server suited for massive in-memory database systems, large-scale enterprise resource planning deployments, and memory-bound analytics pipelines requiring sustained multi-core processing power.
